finalLetter:
Three years ago, I found you.

And since that day, every ordinary moment has become extraordinary. The quiet mornings, the late-night talks, the silly jokes, the way you look at me when you think I'm not watching — they all mean the world to me.

You are my favorite adventure, my safest place, and the most beautiful story I've ever been part of.

Here's to forever and always.

All my love,
{{MY_NAME}}
